content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IGH Dwarka?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Indira Gandhi Hospital Dwarka is scheduled for 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree with a minimum of 02 years of work experience in a recognized hospital, with at least one year in the concerned specialty, and a PG Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts across various specialties like Pathology, Microbiology, Radiology, and Emergency Medicine.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be appointed on Adhoc basis and will receive a salary as per Pay Matrix Level 11, ranging from Rs 67,700 to Rs 2,08,700/- per month, plus allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Senior Resident posts at IGH Dwarka.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by Indira Gandhi Hospital Dwarka.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Indira Gandhi Hospital Dwarka, located in Dwarka, Delhi, with pincode 110077.
